test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which of the following sports India did NOT win a gold medal in Commonwealth Games 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shooting**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India has won a total of 61 medals in the Commonwealth Games 2022.

 
 
• 22 gold,
 
• 16 silver, and
 
• 23 bronze
 
 
 
• This time **shooting **was not included. Therefore India does not won any medal.
 
• In the 2018 Commonwealth Games, India won a total of 66 medals out of which 16 were in shooting.
 
• India finished fourth in the medal tally.
 
• Australia took first place.
 
• England finished second and Canada third.
 
• New Zealand finished fifth.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Commonwealth Games often referred to as the Friendly Games, is an international multi-sport event.
 
• It involves athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• The event was first held in 1930, and, with the exception of 1942 and 1946, has taken place every four years since then.
 
• The 2022 Commonwealth Games took place at the Alexander Stadium in Birmingham, England, from 28 July to 8 August 2022.
 
• Perry the Bull is Birmingham 2022's official mascot.
 
• Indian men's hockey team captain Manpreet Singh & shuttler PV Sindhu were India's flag-bearers for the opening ceremony of the Commonwealth Games (CWG) 2022.
